Compare correlated ROC curve areas (AUC) via Mann-Whitney contrasts

Source: R/roc.r
ks_roc.Rd

R analogue of the classic SAS ROC macro: computes AUC estimates for multiple predictors measured on the same subjects, estimates their covariance matrix using Mann-Whitney components with pairwise deletion, and performs Wald-style tests for user-specified linear contrasts.

Usage

ks_roc(data, var, response, contrast = NULL, details = FALSE, alpha = 0.05)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing predictors and the binary response.

var

Character vector of predictor column names.

response

Single character scalar naming the binary response column coded as 0/1.

contrast

Optional numeric contrast matrix. Columns must match length(var). If NULL (default), all pairwise contrasts AUC_i - AUC_j for i < j are generated.

details

Logical; if TRUE, include intermediate matrices (t, v, nx, ny, lv) in output.

alpha

Significance level for two-sided confidence intervals.

Value

A list with elements:

areas

Data frame with AUC, standard error, and confidence bounds.

contrasts

Data frame with contrast estimates, SE, CI, chi-square, and p-value (1 df each row).

contrast_coefficients

Contrast matrix used in the analysis.

overall_test

Named numeric vector: chi-square, df, p-value for simultaneous contrast test.

pvalue

Overall contrast-test p-value (same as overall_test[["p_value"]]).

details

Only when details = TRUE: list of intermediate matrices t, v, nx, ny, lv.
